Launch, Upgrade, and Conquer the Skies with your plane!


Prepare for an exhilarating aerial adventure in Epic Plane Evolution, where your piloting skills and strategic upgrades determine how far your aircraft can soar. Launch your plane, navigate through diverse terrains, and evolve your aircraft to achieve maximum distance. Whether you're a casual gamer or a flight enthusiast, this game offers a captivating blend of action and strategy.


Epic Plane Evolution is a physics-based flight game that challenges players to launch their aircraft using a slingshot mechanism and guide it through various environments. As you progress, collect coins to upgrade your plane's components, enhancing its performance and unlocking new flight capabilities. Each level introduces unique challenges, requiring precise timing and strategic upgrades to succeed.



Slingshot Launch Mechanics
Initiate each flight by pulling back your plane on a slingshot, determining the initial speed and angle. Mastering this mechanic is crucial for achieving optimal flight paths and distances.


Aircraft Evolution and Upgrades
Accumulate coins during flights to invest in upgrades such as wings, engines, and fuselage enhancements. These improvements not only boost your plane's performance but also unlock new visual designs and capabilities.


Diverse Environments
Navigate through a variety of terrains, each presenting unique obstacles and weather conditions. Adapt your flight strategy to overcome challenges like wind currents, mountainous regions, and urban landscapes.


Strategic Flight Control
While airborne, adjust your plane's pitch and angle to maintain momentum and avoid obstacles. Strategic in-flight decisions can significantly impact your flight distance and coin collection.


Rewarding Progression System
Earn coins based on the distance traveled and successful navigation through obstacles. Use these earnings to continuously upgrade your aircraft, pushing the boundaries of how far you can fly.


Daily Challenges and Rewards
Engage in daily missions that offer additional rewards, encouraging consistent play and providing opportunities to test new strategies and upgrades.


Download and Take Flight!
Embark on your aviation journey today. Download Epic Plane Evolution and experience the thrill of launching, upgrading, and mastering the skies. How far can you fly?

results.description:
Paper Planes Have Never Soared Like This Before!
Ever wondered what the world looks like from the wings of a tiny paper airplane? In Folded Flyer everyday places become extraordinary flying adventures! Take control of your very own paper glider and soar through a colourful 3D world where kitchen counters become mountains, coffee tables turn into dangerous obstacles, and every corner might hide a new surprise. Race against the clock, explore every nook and cranny, or simply enjoy the thrill of guiding your little glider through a world that suddenly feels enormous. Folded Flyer is a fun and creative paper airplane flying game packed with exciting levels, hidden collectibles, customisable planes, powerful upgrades, and plenty of airborne challenges. Whether you’re chasing the fastest flight time, highest scores, hunting for hidden treasures, or designing the coolest paper plane imaginable, there’s always another reason to spread your wings and take off!


► SMALL PAPER PLANES, BIG ADVENTURES
Who knew a paper airplane could have such a big adventure? Explore colourful 3D environments filled with playful animations, unexpected dangers, tricky obstacles, and secrets waiting to be discovered. Everyday objects become exciting challenges when you’re flying at paper plane size. Navigate narrow spaces, avoid obstacles, and discover hidden collectibles as you explore a miniature world full of surprises. Every flight is another opportunity to discover something new!

► RACE, EXPLORE & MASTER THE SKIES
Think you’ve got what it takes to become the ultimate paper pilot? Race through challenging levels, perfect your flying skills, and reach the finish line as quickly as possible. Prefer taking the scenic route? Explore each environment at your own pace and search for hidden rewards. Whether you’re a speedy flyer or a curious explorer, every level offers another fun challenge worth tackling.

► DESIGN YOUR DREAM PAPER AIRPLANE
Your paper plane, your rules! Get creative with the Plane Designer and customize your very own flying masterpiece with a huge variety of colours, patterns, upgrades and designs. Choose colourful flowers, pink hearts, tough camouflage, or a shiny metallic look. Mix and match your favorite styles and colours to create a paper glider that’s completely your own. Why settle for an ordinary airplane when you can fly something spectacular?

► UPGRADE YOUR GLIDER
Even the best paper pilots need a little extra power! Complete levels, beat high scores, and earn upgrades to improve your airplane’s flying abilities. Increase acceleration, durability or sharpen your cornering and boost your speed to take on tougher flying challenges. Keep improving your aircraft and discover just how fast your paper glider can go!

► EASY TO LEARN, FUN TO MASTER
Ready for takeoff? Folded Flyer makes flying easy with simple and intuitive controls. Use the innovative one-finger Tap and Steer controls, use the basic on-screen touch controls for quick and easy flying, or take control with tilt steering using your device’s motion sensors. Getting started is simple, but mastering every turn and perfecting your flight takes practice! Folded Flyer offers fun, optional gyroscopic controls.

► MADE FOR PAPER PLANE & FLYING GAME FANS
Love paper airplanes, flying games, airplane simulators, arcade challenges, or casual adventure games? Then Folded Flyer is ready for takeoff! Combining colourful 3D graphics, creative airplane customization, exciting flight challenges, satisfying upgrades, and hidden collectibles, Folded Flyer brings a playful twist to classic airplane games. Whether you’re looking for a fun flight simulator experience, a relaxing glider adventure, or a skill-based arcade flying game, your next airborne adventure is just one tap away.

► JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Stay up to date on Folded Flyer and other games. We would love to hear what you think. Leave a review to help Folded Flyer grow, or reach out to Rumble Spark Games: https://rumblespark.com
